text:
Liam O'Connor: Heads up — Pioneer Diagnostics (acct:pioneer-dx-prod) onboarding test is failing. Their APAC region traffic is being dropped by our edge ACLs. They asked for an allowlist plus a temporary throughput bump for migration testing.

Ana Gomez: Can you paste the ticket and the customer IP blocks? I'll coordinate with Enablement for the test window.

Liam O'Connor: Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4999
Customer reported IPs: 45.33.12.0/26, 45.33.13.128/25, 203.113.5.64/27
Requested delta: baseline 150 rps -> 650 rps in ap-northeast-1, window 72h starting 2024-07-20 09:30 JST.

Raj Patel: Noted. Renewal check: Pioneer has an upsell review in ~8 weeks. If onboarding stalls >48h it pushes them into "needs exec". We'll prioritize.

Ana Gomez: I'm scheduling the enablement session during the migration test and will join the call. Please confirm contact on customer side so we can invite.

Liam O'Connor: Contact is Mina Park <mina@pioneer-dx.com>. Test ETA 2024-07-20 09:30 JST. Adding Mina to CS-4999.

Jules (infra-bot): Change request created: INF-9027. Preparing per-account ACL in ap-northeast-1.

Raj Patel: Prefer per-account rule scoped to the customer's account and not org-wide. Pushing config now. Will also pin model routing to redwood-optimized/gpt-small-quant to normalize perf during test.

Raj Patel: Config snippet:
```
- account: pioneer-dx-prod
  region: ap-northeast-1
  allowlist:
    - 45.33.12.0/26
    - 45.33.13.128/25
    - 203.113.5.64/27
  rate_limit_override:
    from_rps: 150
    to_rps: 650
    duration_hours: 72
  model_route_override: redwood-optimized/gpt-small-quant
```

Jules (infra-bot): Applying rollout across edge pool (3 nodes). Estimated apply time: 00:03:40.

Raj Patel: Observability tags: cs_account=pioneer-dx, cs_event=migration_test. I'll watch p95 latency and 5xx rate. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 2m.

Ana Gomez: I'll be on the enablement call and collecting quality feedback. Priya from the customer will run the canary prompt set and report results.

Jules (infra-bot): INF-9027: ACL and rate override deployed to ap-northeast-1 in 00:03:55. No immediate errors. :white_check_mark:

Liam O'Connor: Great. Noting the temporary window expiry set to 2024-07-23T09:30:00+09:00 with automated rollback.

CS Automation: CS-4999 updated: onboarding:egress_allowlist_apac -> in_progress. Added customer contact Mina Park.

Ana Gomez: After the test please ask customer to confirm: (1) successful API responses for their primary endpoints, (2) observed latency at p95, (3) any error traces. We'll mark the step complete only after their confirmation.

Liam O'Connor: Customer reported test start at 09:31 JST. Quick update at 09:50: no errors, p95 ~140ms. They will run full load until 11:00 JST and share final status.

Jules (infra-bot): Monitoring hooks active: trace=pioneer-migration-20240720. No spike in 5xx in first 20m.

Ana Gomez: Thanks. I'm capturing notes for the renewal playbook — include how we handle temporary RL increases and per-account ACL templates. Customer asked for a short diagram of edge peering too.

Liam O'Connor: Customer confirmed completion at 11:03 JST: all endpoints ok, no 5xx, sustained throughput at target, p95 135ms. They're good to proceed with onboarding.

CS Automation: CS-4999 updated: onboarding_step=egress_allowlist_apac -> done.

Raj Patel: Filed INF-9027-ops: templated per-account ACL snippets and rollback playbook.

Ana Gomez: Filed doc request for regional peering diagram and a short how-to for customers on allowlist steps. Linking to CS-4999.

Liam O'Connor: Reducing immediate renewal risk to "green". Thanks team! :tada:
